detail.longDescription: I created Zaytun because it is something I personally needed. I’m blind, and for years I’ve often had to adapt to tools and games that weren’t designed with people like me in mind. Instead of waiting for someone else to build what I wished existed, I decided to build it myself. Zaytun started as a personal idea, but I hope it can become a place where anyone can create and enjoy games, regardless of how they see the world. 🌿 # OpenSource # IndieDev # TextAdventure # CODE # GameDev # Programming
